changeinfo.changes:
FEATURE UPDATES: - In-Game Store has been enabled. - XP progression level caps have been set for the Public Beta. - Overtime rules in tie-breaking game modes now display final tally at the end of overtime.
BUG FIXES: - Stability with parties and matchmaking has been improved. - Team balancing in game lobbies now works correctly. - Guardian Scorestreak audio no longer stays in the map at the location it was placed if it gets moved or destroyed. - Scorestreak activation is no longer disabled after a host migration.
